//: Example wiring for BOTH 4SYNC ARCH hooks: the guard + session-debt hook (hooks/pre_tool_use.py, PreToolUse) and the boot receipt (hooks/session_start.py, SessionStart). PROJECT scope: copy to .claude/settings.local.json and adjust paths. USER scope (covers every ARCH instance on the machine, and closes the launch-directory bypass): copy the same 'hooks' block to ~/.claude/settings.json, WITHOUT the 'env' block below — see README 'Where to wire them'. THE SessionStart BLOCK BELONGS AT USER LEVEL SPECIFICALLY: the sessions that skip boot are the ones launched OUTSIDE the instance, and those never read project settings at all, so project-level wiring puts it where it is least needed. scripts/wire_hooks.py writes the PreToolUse block only and prints the SessionStart block for you to paste. SEVEN structural guards: KERNEL-write, ABBA-format, sandbox-git, STATUS-snapshot, boring-guard, root-fence, STATUS-stale-write — plus a session-debt recorder that flags a session which worked but never ran an explicit close. NO ARCH_HOOKS_MODE IS PINNED BELOW, DELIBERATELY: a mode written here OVERRIDES the installed hook's own default and keeps overriding it through every future update, silently. Leave it unset to follow what ships. Set it ONLY to pin this machine on purpose: 'warn' logs the finding and returns no permission decision, 'enforce' blocks or asks, 'off' disables. Earlier versions of this file pinned 'warn' and that is why adopters wired before v1.1.6 keep it -- run `python scripts/wire_hooks.py --status`, which now says so. Adjust the interpreter + script + log paths to your checkout; forward slashes work on Windows, and use the FULL python path if bare 'python' is shadowed by the Store stub. After creating this file, reload: open /hooks once or restart the session, since a freshly-created .claude/ is not watched mid-session. Optional env: ARCH_DEBT=0 disables the debt recorder; ARCH_MANIFEST sets the manifest filename the boring-guard watches (default 4SYNC.yaml). KEEP COMMENTS IN THIS SINGLE '//' KEY: a NAMED comment key such as '//note' was rejected by the settings schema.
